mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing 61-degree temperatures with overcast skies near the Military Ridge State Trail under a waxing crescent moon. Also, please note that the ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

The Verona Police Department has published a report summarizing notable calls for service from October 5 through October 12, covering various incidents including traffic accidents and an arrest on an outstanding warrant.

Today is a busy day in town. You can enjoy Live Music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, the Downtown Farmer's Market, Pizza and a Pitcher at Lake Lou-ee, and Trivia Night at both The Mill and The Bogey Factory. Looking ahead, you can check out ART House 360 or Hop Haus Trivia tomorrow, and Live Music at Bailey's Run or Lake Lou-ee this coming Friday.
In our weekly police report, on October 7, officers responded to a motor vehicle crash at Basswood Avenue and Hemlock Drive involving a juvenile operating an electric motorcycle.
Today's flavor of the day is Dark Chocolate Decadence. The store opens today at 10:00 AM, so be sure to stop by and satisfy your sweet tooth.
